about: Baikal: Ulan-Ude International Airport, operating since 1926, near Lake Baikal. Runway length 3,000 m.

transport.title: Getting there
transport.text: City buses No. 10, 55 and 77 run via the centre (Ploshchad Sovetov stop) to the airport station forecourt. Service starts at 6:15 on weekdays and 7:00 at weekends, interval 7–10 minutes; the fare on No. 55 is 40 ₽. By car about 20 minutes from the centre.

storage.title: Left luggage
storage.text: Left luggage in the domestic terminal, on Level 1, from 6:00 to 20:00. One item 270 ₽ per calendar day, an item over 203 cm (sum of three dimensions) 550 ₽.

kids.title: With children
kids.text: Mother and child room on Level 2, in the right wing of the terminal, free and open round the clock, up to 3 hours. For children under 7 with one adult, children with disabilities under 14, large families with a certificate and women in the second half of pregnancy.

parking.title: Parking
parking.text: Short-stay P1 at the terminal: up to 15 minutes free, 16–60 minutes 500 ₽, second hour 300 ₽, third and fourth 200 ₽ each, from minute 241 1,200 ₽, no longer than 24 hours. Long-stay: up to 3 days 800 ₽ per day, from the 4th to the 6th 500 ₽.

wifi.title: Wi‑Fi
wifi.text: Free Wi‑Fi: network FreeAirportBaikalRT, login with a phone number and an SMS code.
